research.zh: 研究論文或研究報告：提出研究問題、方法、實驗或模型，分析結果並形成研究結論。
research.en: Research paper or report presenting a research question, methods, experiments or models, results and scientific conclusions.

manual.zh: 操作手冊：說明工具或軟體的安裝、設定、操作步驟及功能使用方法。
manual.en: User manual explaining installation, configuration, operating steps and how to use a tool or software.

guidance.zh: 工程應用指引或施工規範：提供材料選用、配比、施工、品質檢驗的建議或要求。
guidance.en: Engineering guidance or construction specification providing recommendations or requirements for material selection, mixtures, construction and quality inspection.

safety.zh: 安全資料表：說明產品成分、危害辨識、急救措施、暴露防護及安全處置。
safety.en: Safety data sheet describing product composition, hazard identification, first aid, exposure controls and safe handling.

industry.zh: 企業年報、永續報告或產業報告：揭露營運、財務、營收、排放與永續績效。
industry.en: Corporate annual, sustainability or industry report disclosing operations, financial results, revenue, emissions and sustainability performance.

experiment_log.zh: 實驗記錄：逐次記載試驗日期、試體編號、操作條件、量測數值、原始觀察與異常的紀錄表或實驗日誌。
experiment_log.en: Experiment log or laboratory record documenting run dates, specimen identifiers, operating conditions, measurements, raw observations and anomalies.

manuscript_notes.zh: 手稿筆記：草稿、工作筆記、課堂筆記、講義或課堂投影片；可打字或手寫。以記錄想法或教學整理為主，子類分開標記。正式研究報告與設備操作手冊不屬此類。
manuscript_notes.en: Draft manuscripts, working notes, classroom notes, course handouts or lecture slides, typed or handwritten, recording ideas or teaching material. Track subtypes separately; exclude formal research reports and equipment operating manuals.
